title: Off-target posterior mass: A training-free diagnostic for fine-tuning spoken language diarization probes
abstract: arXiv:2611.13430v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spoken Language Diarization (SLD) models provide frame-level language information of a speech recording. SLD modeling pipeline includes feature extraction from pre-trained speech models followed by clustering. Fine-tuning pre-trained speech models has shown performance gains for SLD with its magnitude being dataset dependent. Off-target Posterior Mass (OTPM), computed based on posterior language identification probabilities is proposed as a diagnostic metric to forecast performance gains from SLD fine-tuning. OTPM obtains positive correlation with probe gains, 0.56 on unseen synthetic bilingual data and 0.23 on real-world corpora. These results indicate promising potential of OTPM as a diagnostic metric for SLD.

translated_title: 脱靶后验质量：一种用于微调口语语言日志化探针的免训练诊断方法
translated_abstract: 口语语言日志化（SLD）模型可提供语音录音的帧级语言信息。SLD建模流程包括从预训练语音模型中提取特征，随后进行聚类。微调预训练语音模型已被证明可以为SLD带来性能提升，但提升幅度取决于具体数据集。本文提出了基于后验语言识别概率计算的脱靶后验质量（OTPM），作为一种诊断指标，用于预测SLD微调所带来的性能提升。OTPM与探针增益呈正相关，在未见过的合成双语数据上相关系数为0.56，在真实世界语料库上为0.23。这些结果表明OTPM作为SLD诊断指标具有广阔的应用前景。
tldr: 本文提出一种免训练的诊断指标——脱靶后验质量（OTPM），基于后验语言识别概率预测微调预训练语音模型为口语语言日志化（SLD）带来的性能提升，其与探针增益呈正相关（合成双语数据上为0.56，真实语料上为0.23）。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Off-target Posterior Mass (OTPM), a training-free diagnostic metric computed from posterior language identification probabilities that forecasts performance gains from fine-tuning pre-trained speech models for Spoken Language Diarization, showing positive correlation with probe gains (0.56 on synthetic bilingual data and 0.23 on real-world corpora).
